webhooksSection.step1: Read the X-Harly-Signature-256 header. It looks like t=1735689600,v1=9f2c….
webhooksSection.step2: Compute HMAC-SHA256 with your signing secret over {payload}, as hex. Use the raw body, not re-serialized JSON.
webhooksSection.step3: Compare it with v1 in constant time and reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.
webhooksSection.deliveryRulesBody: Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds. Failed deliveries are retried with growing delays, from 1 minute up to 24 hours, then marked as failed. Other headers: X-Harly-Event and X-Harly-Delivery (use it to de-duplicate).
